patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Airtable and Todoist share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Airtable only if your buying job matches “Flexible database / app platform with interfaces and light project apps — Team from ~$20/u” rather than Todoist's shape. Choose Todoist only if your buying job matches “Personal and team task manager with natural-language capture — Free; Pro from ~$6.25/user/” rather than Airtable's shape. Workflow advantage: Airtable leans work-management; Todoist leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Airtable and Todoist share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Airtable is Flexible database / app platform with interfaces and light project apps — Team from ~$20/user/mo annual.; Todoist is Personal and team task manager with natural-language capture — Free; Pro from ~$6.25/user/mo annual; Business ~$10..
- Company-size focus: Airtable (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Todoist (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Airtable-leaning work-management vs Todoist-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Airtable — Higher seat floors than Notion/ClickUp; Todoist — Not a Work OS or portfolio tool.

Limitations — Airtable: Higher seat floors than Notion/ClickUp; Builder complexity; Todoist: Not a Work OS or portfolio tool; Team features mainly on Business.

Poor-fit cases: Airtable is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Higher seat floors than Notion/ClickUp · Todoist is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a Work OS or portfolio tool · Avoid Airtable if you actually need Todoist's motion (Personal and team task manager with natural-language capture — Free; Pro from ~$)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
